hero.title: Siyakwamukela e-MavingTech High School
hero.subtitle: Lapho izingqondo ezisha zase-Afrika zinakekelwa zibe abaholi abazethembayo, abasunguli nabaguquli bakusasa.

learning.title: Ukufunda Kuqala Nathi
learning.p1: E-MavingTech High School, sinikeza indawo esekelayo negqugquzelayo yezingqondo ezisha zase-Afrika ukuthi zifunde, zikhule futhi ziphumelele. Uthando lwethu lwemfundo ludlula imiphumela ehle yezemfundo — sakha abacabangi abazethembayo, abadalayo, abalungele ikusasa lomhlaba.
learning.p2: Kusukela kuGrade 8 kuya ku-NSC (Grade 12) / Matric, abafundi bethu baphuma benesimilo, ukuziphatha namakhono okwenza umehluko emhlabeni.

director.title: Kusuka Etafuleni Likathishomkhulu
director.quote: E-MavingTech High School, sikholelwa ukuthi umfundi ngamunye uphethe isipho esikhethekile. Umsebenzi wethu ukondla leso sipho ngokuziphatha, ukholo, ukusebenza kanzima nothando lolwazi — ukuze umfundi ngamunye akhule abe umholi wobuqotho nenjongo.
director.body: Wamukelekile emphakathini wethu wesikole. Sisonke nothisha bethu abazinikele, abazali abasekelayo nabafundi abanamathemba, sakha isikole lapho ukubaluleka kwezemfundo kuhamba ngesandla nesimilo esiqinile. Siyaziqhenya ngalokho abafundi bethu abakhula babe yikho, futhi sikumema ukuthi ube yingxenye yaloluhambo.

curriculum.title: Ukubuka Kwekharikhulamu
curriculum.intro: I-MavingTech ihlose ukunikeza bonke abafundi bethu ikharikhulamu ebanzi neyilinganisiwe enikeza imisebenzi eklomelisayo nekhuthazayo ukubalungiselela impilo yenhlalo namasiko engcono.

cs.desc: Ulwazi lwesenzo lolimi lokuhlela nobuchwepheshe bakamuva.

math.title: Izibalo
math.desc: Ukwakha izisekelo eziqinile zokuhlaziya ngokuxazulula izinkinga zangempela.

lit.title: Ubuciko Nezilimi
lit.desc: Ukwakha ukuzwakalisa, ukuqonda kanye nothando lokufunda nokubhala okuhlala isikhathi eside.

sci.title: Isayensi
sci.desc: Ukufunda okuqhutshwa umbuzo ku-physics, chemistry ne-biology ngezindlu zocwaningo zesimanje.

arts.title: Ubuciko Bokubuka
arts.desc: Amastudiyo okudala lapho abafundi behlola ukudweba, ukupenda, idizayini nomsebenzi wezandla.

perf.title: Ubuciko Bokwenza
perf.desc: Izinhlelo zomculo, umdlalo nomdanso ezakha ukuzethemba nokusebenzisana.

cta.title: Qala Uhambo Lwakho Nathi
cta.desc: Joyina umphakathi ozinikele ekubaluleni kwezemfundo, isimilo nokusungula. Ukubhaliswa kuvuliwe.

about.title: Ngokwe-MavingTech
about.subtitle: Cishe ikhulu leminyaka lokondla izingqondo ezisha zase-Afrika zibe abaholi abazethembayo, abasunguli nabaguquli.
about.history1: I-MavingTech High School, isikole sabafana esidumile sikahulumeni eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika, sasungulwa ngoJanuwari 1927 njenge-Cape Town Technical School, okwenza sibe isikole sokuqala sobuchwepheshe kulokho okwakuyi-Southern Rhodesia.
about.history2: Isikole sathola isimo sesikole samabanga aphakeme ngo-1931 futhi, ngesinyathelo esibalulekile, sathuthela endaweni yaso yamanje eMatopos Road eqondene neSouth Africa International Trade Fair grounds ngo-1953. Ngokuhlonipha umsunguli waso owasebenza isikhathi eside, oholele isikhungo iminyaka engamashumi amabili, isikole saqanjwa kabusha ngokuthi yi-MavingTech Technical High School ngoMhla ka-19 Agasti 1961, kwathi ekugcineni safinyezwa saba yi-MavingTech High School ngo-1974.
about.history3: Namuhla, ngezibalo ezingaphezu kuka-800 zabafundi, siqhubeka nefa lobungcweti kwezemfundo nezemidlalo elifingqwe emhlahlandleleni waso othi, Sinika Amandla Ibhizinisi Lakho Ngobuchwepheshe.

excellence.title: Ukubalulwa
excellence.desc: Ukulwela izindinganiso eziphakeme kuwo wonke umzamo — ezemfundo, ezemidlalo nezomuntu siqu.

integrity.title: Ubuqotho
integrity.desc: Ukuthembeka, ukuziphatha nokuphendula kusenhliziyweni yomphakathi wethu.

innovation.title: Ukusungula
innovation.desc: Ukufuna ukwazi nokudala okulungisa abafundi bethu ezweni elishintsha ngokushesha.

academics.title: Ezemfundo
academics.subtitle: Ikharikhulamu ebanzi neyilinganisiwe ehlanganisa izinhlelo ze-CAPS ne-IEB — eyakhelwe ukulungisela wonke umfundi ikusasa lomhlaba.
academics.intro: I-MavingTech ihlinzeka ngazo zombili izinhlelo zokuhlolwa ze-CAPS ne-IEB (CIE), inikeza abafundi ukuguquguquka kokuzuza iziqu zasekhaya noma zamazwe omhlaba ku-Ordinary ne-Advanced Level.

results.title: Impumelelo Yezemfundo
results.body: Abafundi bethu bahlala benza kahle phakathi kwabaphezulu esifundazweni nasezweni lonke, kunabafundi abaningi abathola i-distinctions kuwo wonke umkhumbi.

admissions.title: Ukubhalisa
admissions.subtitle: Joyina umndeni wase-MavingTech. Samukela abafundi abalangazelela ukufunda, ukukhula nokwenza igalelo emphakathini wethu obuyisayo.

apply.title: Thumela Isicelo
apply.desc: Gcwalisa ifomu elisi-online ngemininingwane yomfundi neyabazali.

form.title: Isicelo Esiku-Inthanethi

contact.title: Xhumana Nathi
contact.subtitle: Singathanda ukuzwa kuwe. Xhumana nathi ngemibuzo noma ubhukhe umhlangano nabaphathi bethu besikole.

fees.title: Izimali Zesikole
fees.intro: Landa uhlelo lwezimali lwakamuva, imininingwane yenkokhelo namadokhumenti ezimali ngezansi.

facilities.title: Izinsizakalo Zethu
facilities.intro: I-MavingTech High School yisikole sabafana kuphela esihlala esikoleni esinikeza izinsizakalo ezinhle ezisekela ukubalulwa kwezemfundo, impumelelo yezemidlalo nokuthuthukiswa okuphelele. Ikhampasi yethu inamagumbi okufundela esimanje, izindlu zocwaningo ezinemishini kahle, izinkundla zemidlalo ezibanzi, umtapo wolwazi ophelele, izinsizakalo ze-ICT nendawo yokuhlala ekhululekile.

sdc.title: Ikomidi Lokuthuthukisa Isikole (SDC)
sdc.body: I-SDC imele izintshisekelo zabazali, abasebenzi nomphakathi, isebenzisana nokuphathwa kwesikole ukuqinisekisa indawo yokufunda ephumelelayo.

pt.title: Imihlangano Yabazali-Othisha
pt.body: Imihlangano evamile phakathi kwabazali nothisha ukuxoxa ngenqubekelaphambili nokuthuthuka komfundi.

boarding.subtitle: Ikhaya kude nekhaya — izinsizakalo zethu zokuhlala zinikeza indawo ephephile nenakelayo lapho abafundi bethuthuka ngokwemfundo nangokwenhlalo.

study.title: Isikhathi Sokufunda Esihleliwe
study.desc: Izikhathi zokuzilungiselela zakusihlwa eziqashelwe ukusekela ukubalulwa kwezemfundo.
